subject: Request: Pro-services & SLA exceptions for Novara POC
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novara.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Redwood Inference POC + Pro Services (Novara)

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Novara is preparing a small POC to validate the EHR connector and tokenization pipeline; procurement asked me to get a firm statement of work and pricing for the POC + the recommended pro services bundle (onboarding + premium support + custom connector build).

High-level asks from our side:
- 1x 3-month POC (hosted) with sample dataset (PHI),
- custom FHIR connector to our Epic instance (scope: patient-level sync + normalized schema),
- onboarding (knowledge transfer + runbook),
- premium support during POC (24/7 pager + weekly QBR) — customer expects coverage.

Budget is tight for the pilot. Can you provide an SOW and let me know if Novara can get a services discount or any credit for an eventual committed deployment? Procurement also asked about non-standard SLA language (short, pilot-support clauses) and whether Redwood can accept a 90-day acceptance window for the connector work.

Attaching Novara_RFP.pdf (high level). Happy to hop on a call. Need numbers by EOD Friday if possible.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Integrations, Novara Health
Samantha.Lee@novara.io

Attachments: Novara_RFP.pdf
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood Inference POC + Pro Services (Novara) — Exec approval needed

Team — forwarding Novara's ask. Quick summary and recommendation (numbers in attachment):

TL;DR: Novara requests POC + custom FHIR connector + 24/7 premium support during pilot. They want a discount on services and a relaxed acceptance window (90 days). Procurement wants pricing and SOW by Friday.

Our recommended commercial posture:
- Services discount: 25% off list services for the pilot (to convert into standard pricing on committed deal),
- Premium support: include 3 months of Premium Support for the POC (no additional seat charge),
- Onboarding cap: 120 hours (billable overage),
- Custom connector: fixed-scope SOW (deliverable + success criteria),
- Non-standard term: 90-day acceptance limited to connector functional tests; decline SLA re-writes for pilot beyond credits.

Requesting exec sign-off on two exceptions for Deal Desk:
1) Discount > standard approval threshold (requesting approval for 25% services discount).
2) Elevated premium support inclusion (waive standard charge for pilot).

Attached: SOW_v2.pdf (draft), discount_matrix.xlsx (approval bands). Also flag legal review on the acceptance window language — would prefer to keep limited to pilot tests only.

Can you reply with quick thumbs-up / redlines? Rishi — if you approve, I'll commit a provisional concession and send updated SOW + DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_v2.pdf; discount_matrix.xlsx
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Redwood Inference POC + Pro Services (Novara) — Exec approval needed

Neha — thanks for the quick summary. I am generally supportive but with explicit guardrails. Approvals below (conditions apply):

1) Discount: approve up to 20% off professional services for the POC as a one-time concession conditional on Novara committing to at least a 12-month hosted usage agreement within 90 days post-POC. 25% exceeds our typical delegation for AE signoff; we can do 25% only with VP approval (Marissa).

2) Premium support: approve inclusion of up to 3 months of Premium Support (pilot only) — must be timeboxed and not impact capacity of paid customers. Any 24/7 escalation coverage beyond pilots must be purchased separately.

3) Onboarding cap: keep 120 hours cap; overages bill at standard T&M rates.

4) Acceptance window: legal must sign off on 90-day pilot acceptance language. No permanent SLA changes. Copy Legal on next SOW iteration; they must add firm test cases/criteria.

5) Payment: Novara must deliver a PO for services and net-30 payment terms for the SOW. Any longer payable terms require Finance (Markus) sign-off.

Action for you: revise SOW to reflect 20% discount (unless Marissa approves 25%), cap hours, include acceptance criteria, route to Legal + DocuSign. If Marissa gives VP override for 25% we can accept 25% but include an up-sell escalation plan in the commercial summary.

Marissa — quick call for the 25% ask? If you can approve 25% we can move faster.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novara.io>, Novara Procurement <procurement@novara.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Redwood Inference POC + Pro Services (Novara)

Samantha / Procurement — thanks for the patience. We're provisionally approved to proceed with the pilot concessions below; finalization pending legal and DocuSign but we can lock commercial terms quickly so you can schedule engineering work.

Provisional agreed terms (summary):
- Services discount: 20% off professional services for the POC (one-time concession; contingent on 12-month hosted usage commitment within 90 days post-POC),
- Premium Support: include 3 months of Premium Support during the pilot (timeboxed),
- Onboarding: up to 120 hours included; billable overage at standard T&M,
- Custom FHIR connector: fixed-scope deliverable with acceptance criteria (we'll include connector test cases in SOW),
- Acceptance window: pilot acceptance tests limited to connector functional tests; 90-day window for remediation and verification,
- Payment: PO required; net-30 for SOW (any different payment term needs Finance approval).

Next steps:
1) I will attach the updated SOW (SOW_final_v3.pdf) and route for legal review.
2) We'll send DocuSign for the SOW and quote (link below) — please sign to trigger scheduling.
3) Once we get signed SOW + PO, engineering will begin scoping and schedule an architecture kickoff (target within 5 business days).

DocuSign (provisional link): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3487234/DEAL-2026-0147

Attachments included for your review: SOW_final_v3.pdf (updated pricing + acceptance criteria).

If this is acceptable I'll route to Legal immediately and we can lock dates.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_final_v3.pdf
